name: j-jayes
description: Jonathan Jayes' Claude Code plugins: the Nexer slide kit and its companion skills.

plugins.name: slides
plugins.description: Twenty-four Claude Code skills for building slide decks and the charts that go in them: deck structure, Nexer branding and PowerPoint export, McKinsey-style rigour, a thirteen-skill ggplot2 data-visualisation family, plus TDD, manual testing, git discipline and more. The Quarto slide kit itself is the repo, not the plugin.
